entries.originalConcern: A delayed pg_net wake or interrupted private handler could leave a preflight evidence record indefinitely queued/running.
entries.freshVerificationResult: Found during local security/recovery review before deployment. The initial canary state machine had no terminal expiry for a wake that never reached the route or a handler that stopped after claim.
entries.rootCause: The first canary implementation bounded HMAC acceptance but had not yet bounded stale durable work states.
entries.correctiveAction: Added expiry closure at the start of each hourly canary delivery: queued records older than three minutes become delivery_failed and running records older than five minutes become failed. HMAC acceptance is bounded to the pg_net two-minute request window.
tests: SQL state-machine review completed
migration mirror/source guard passed
entries.rollbackMethod: Unschedule veroxa-media-inspection-preflight and retain private terminal records; no customer media or external write is involved.

entries.originalConcern: A Storage metadata or signed-URL request could stall before the transformed response timeout starts, leaving the health route without a bounded dependency failure.
entries.freshVerificationResult: Verified during the final local security review: the first adapter timeout covered the transformed fetch but not Storage info or signing operations.
entries.rootCause: The initial bounded-response implementation did not race Storage SDK metadata and signing promises against the same bounded deadline.
entries.correctiveAction: Added a bounded timeout wrapper around pre-transform object info, signed transform URL creation, and post-transform object recheck; all timeout paths normalize to storage_transform_timeout without raw diagnostics.
tests: stalled metadata and signing regression test passed
stalled transformed-response regression test passed
entries.rollbackMethod: Re-deploy Sites v56; no database data mutation or customer-media mutation is introduced by this application-only timeout control.

entries.originalConcern: A trusted decoder result could be accepted for a JPEG whose own structural compatibility parser produced no valid dimensions.
entries.freshVerificationResult: Verified in local code review before deployment: the compatibility branch allowed a null structural result when host dimensions matched.
entries.rootCause: The compatibility condition used a permissive null branch instead of requiring a structurally compatible JPEG or PNG before accepting the independent transform decode.
entries.correctiveAction: Require compatible source MIME and dimensions before accepting the trusted transform result; added a malformed JPEG-with-magic regression scenario that must dead-letter without completion.
tests: malformed JPEG magic-plus-host-result regression test passed
compatible trailing-byte JPEG recovery regression test passed
entries.rollbackMethod: Re-deploy Sites v56; preserve the asset, original bytes, and durable exception records unchanged.

entries.originalConcern: The active media-inspection forward candidate could bypass the historical immutable application source-tree guard without an exact changed-path constraint.
entries.freshVerificationResult: Confirmed by completed Codex Security scan 623563ae-5aad-4b0c-b6bb-9aa2f134137e against its immutable local snapshot. The active-candidate early return validated migration and lock metadata but not the full candidate source scope.
entries.rootCause: The temporary forward-candidate exception replaced the ordinary source-tree identity assertion without imposing a strict candidate diff allowlist.
entries.correctiveAction: Added a base-commit-bound exact Git changed-path allowlist. The guard now rejects unexpected, missing, or deleted candidate paths before accepting the active forward candidate.

entries.originalConcern: The new preflight migration selected a literal production endpoint, allowing a non-production project with a shared HMAC to emit a signed production-directed wake.
entries.freshVerificationResult: Confirmed by completed Codex Security scan 623563ae-5aad-4b0c-b6bb-9aa2f134137e against its immutable local snapshot. The route nonce claim reduced direct impact but did not establish environment-bound delivery.
entries.rootCause: Endpoint selection was hardcoded rather than gated by an allowlisted per-environment Vault configuration invariant.
entries.correctiveAction: Added a Veroxa-named Vault accessor for a dedicated preflight endpoint and require an exact production endpoint match before pg_net delivery. Missing or mismatched configuration records a local delivery_failed state without a network request.
